title: Horse Summoner
description: Adds an item that summons tamed horses
body:
# Horse Summoner

I hate how you can't really travel over the ocean with a horse. if you have a horse on one island, you have to use something like the nether to get it to  another island

That's why I made the Horse Summoner mod. First, craft the Horse Summoner item with a carrot on a stick and a compass. It has the same texture as a carrot on a stick because I can't do texturing.

Next, tame a horse, donkey, or mule and use the Horse Summoner item on the horse. You should see that it has an enchantment glint now. Now from anywhere in the world, you can use the horse summoner item and the horse "linked" to that item will appear within a small radius around you. Please note that the horse may be behind you

You can have multiple different horses linked to multiple different summoners. I'd recommend naming them with an anvil just to keep track of which horse is summoned by which item


KNOWN ISSUES: The summoner won't work if it's out of render distance. This is a limitation with how I coded it, and I'm not sure of a way to fix it

I reccomend solving this by stopping at a few islands along the way if you're traveling over water. if that still doesn't work, try turning your render distance all the way up for a few seconds
